rows.name: Augury
rows.description: Choose a specific course of action intended for the next 30 minutes, then cast tokens or bones. The omen indicates favorable results, unfavorable results, or a mixture of both; no omen means no strong result either way. It provides no details or explanation. Casting again before a rest risks a random false reading.

rows.name: Charm Person
rows.description: On a failed WIS save, the humanoid becomes charmed and considers you a friendly acquaintance. Harming it ends the effect; otherwise, the charm lasts for the spell’s duration. The humanoid has advantage on this save when fighting you or any of your allies.

rows.name: Commune with Nature
rows.description:
Flora or Fauna:  Choose how nature transforms you. 

Fauna: Take an animal form to increase your speed by 10ft, gain advantage on STR-based attacks, and deal an extra 3d8 force damage on melee hits; or...

Flora: Take a rooted form that creates grasping roots extending 15ft around you.  Ensnares enemies (save vs. STR), grants allies within that area advantage against fear, and lets your ranged attacks ignore cover.  Caster is rooted in place for the duration.

targets.to: self; Flora roots affect enemies and allies within 15ft

rows.reason: Use the reviewed forms, damage and STR restraint save.

rows.name: Comprehend Languages
rows.description: While the spell lasts, speech you hear in any language is intelligible to you at a literal level. Writing in any language is likewise intelligible, but only while you touch the surface bearing it. Ciphers, secret codes, and non-linguistic symbols remain undecoded. This understanding grants no ability to speak or write the language.

rows.name: Dancing Lights
rows.description: Create up to six fist-sized points of light (or combine them into one vaguely humanoid glow) within range and move them as a bonus action; each sheds dim light in a 10ft radius.

targets.from: up to four lights or one glowing form
targets.to: up to six lights or one glowing form

rows.reason: The description explicitly creates six lights.

rows.name: Divination
rows.description: Make an offering and perform a ritual to receive your deity’s truthful answer to ONE question. Choose a particular objective, occurrence, or undertaking expected within 7 days. The response takes the form of an omen, a brief phrase, or an enigmatic rhyme, revealing the future as it currently stands rather than hypothetical outcomes. Casting again before a rest risks a random false reading.

rows.name: Druidic
rows.description: You speak Druidic fluently, sharing a private tongue with other druids.

rows.name: Flame Strike
rows.description: A 10' diameter pillar of holy fire crashes down from above; each creature in it makes a DEX save against 4d6 fire + 4d6 radiant (half on a success).

targets.to: 10ft-diameter, 40ft-tall column

rows.reason: Diameter, not radius, is explicit in the reviewed prose.

rows.name: For Whom the Bell Tolls
rows.description: The target envisions their own demise. The target must make a WIS save or take 1d8 necrotic — 1d12 if it is already below its hit point maximum.

rows.name: Half-Fey Charm
rows.description: Innate fey heritage: cast Charm Person once per day without a spell slot.

rows.name: Hide from Undead
rows.description: Mindless undead cannot detect warded creatures. Intelligent undead must succeed on a WIS save to detect them. A warded creature loses this protection if it attacks.

rows.name: Identify
rows.description: Handle an object through the casting to learn whether it is magical, what its properties are and how to use them. Cast on a creature, learn what spells or curses currently affect it (if any).

targets.to: 1 object or creature

rows.reason: The description can determine whether an object is magical; targets need not already be magical.

rows.name: Mask of the Wild
rows.description: Even the slightest natural phenomenon provides enough cover for you to hide.  Leaves, snow, fog, even heavy rain all count.

rows.name: Necrotic Nova
rows.description: A shockwave of necrotic energy explodes outward from the caster; every living creature inside takes 8d6 necrotic, CON for half.

targets.to: living creatures in a 20ft-radius sphere centered on the caster

rows.reason: The shockwave originates from the caster, not a distant point.

rows.name: Shadow Blade
rows.description: Weave shadows into a blade of absolute darkness (2d8 psychic, finesse, thrown 20/60); you have advantage on attacks with it in dim light or darkness.

rows.name: Silence
rows.description: Create a 20ft-radius sphere of absolute silence. Creatures inside cannot cast spells with verbal components; all sonic attacks, including thunder damage, are negated there.

rows.name: Speak with Animals
rows.description: Communicate with animals. They can share what they have sensed recently, but are limited by animal intelligence and perspective.  Just because they CAN communicate back, doesn't mean they WILL.  The spell does not affect their disposition towards the caster.

targets.to: nearby animals

rows.reason: Communication has animal recipients rather than no target.

rows.name: A Call to Arms
rows.description: Raise the countryside: conscript 5d10 locals into an army under your command — each soldier is level 2d6, armed appropriately to their station, and they fight with discipline borrowed from you for as long as you lead them. You may keep one such army at a time; raising a new one disbands the old.

rows.name: Arcane Lock
rows.description: Magically seal a closable object: it is locked and barred to all but those you designate at casting (you may also set a password that suppresses the seal for 1 minute when spoken within 5ft). Knock suppresses it for 10 minutes; breaking or picking it is 10 harder than normal.

rows.name: Aura of Life
rows.description: Life-preserving radiance surrounds you. Allies in the aura resist necrotic damage and their maximum HP cannot be reduced; any ally at 0 HP that starts its turn in the aura wakes with 1 HP.

rows.name: Bleed
rows.description: The target bleeds from every orifice, taking 1d4 necrotic at the start of each of its turns for 1d10 turns or until you cancel it.

rows.name: Blind
rows.description: The target makes a CON save or is blinded for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

rows.name: Booming Blade
rows.description: A melee weapon attack sheathed in thunder; if the target willingly moves before the end of your next turn, it takes 1d8 thunder.

rows.name: Chill Touch
rows.description: A ghostly hand (ranged spell attack); 1d8 necrotic and the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Undead also have disadvantage on attacks against you until then.

rows.name: Cone of Cold
rows.description: A blast of killing frost pours from your hands; every creature within the cone makes a CON save against 8d8 cold. Creatures slain by it freeze where they stand, rimed statues until they thaw.

rows.name: Confusion
rows.description: Affected creatures lose track of friend, foe and intent: each turn one wanders, one attacks whatever is nearest, one stands babbling. A creature may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

rows.name: Counterspell
rows.description: Automatically negate a spell of 3rd tier or lower. For a higher-tier spell, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + that spell's tier) to interrupt it.  Requires line of sight to the caster.

rows.name: Cunning Action
rows.description: Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a bonus action on each of your turns.

rows.name: Cure Wounds
rows.description: Touch a creature to restore 1d8 + your spellcasting modifier HP. No effect on undead or constructs.

rows.name: Death Ward
rows.description: A ward against the grave. Protects the target from dropping to 0 or less HP, instead it drops to 1 and the ward burns out; an effect that would kill outright without dealing damage is negated instead, spending the ward.

rows.name: Detect Magic
rows.description: Sense magic within 30ft; as an action, see a faint aura around a visible magical creature or object and learn its tradition. Blocked by 1ft of stone, 1in of metal, or 3ft of wood. It DETECTS only — learning an item's specific properties is Identify.

rows.name: Divine Sense
rows.description: Sense the location of any undead, fiend, or celestial within 60ft, and any consecrated or desecrated place, until the end of your next turn.

duration.to: until the end of your next turn

rows.reason: The effect includes the next turn, rather than ending at its beginning.

rows.name: Dominate Beast
rows.description: Seize a beast's mind. It obeys your commands — even self-destructive ones — and you can perceive through its senses by concentrating. Each time it takes damage it re-saves, and success shakes it free.

rows.name: Dread
rows.description: A creature (not undead or construct) makes a WIS save or is frightened of you, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

rows.name: Elemental Orb
rows.description: A ranged spell attack hurling a 4-inch orb of acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder (you choose) for 3d8.

rows.name: Expertise
rows.description: Double your proficiency bonus on checks with a chosen skill you are proficient in (fixed when the expertise was gained — e.g. Stealth, Deception, Thieves' Tools).

rows.name: Extra Attack
rows.description: Each attack action you take grants two attacks.

rows.name: Faerie Fire
rows.description: Each creature in the cube that fails a DEX save is outlined in light: attacks against it have advantage and it cannot benefit from invisibility.

rows.name: Fear
rows.description: Each creature in the cone sees its own worst thing; on a failed WIS save it drops what it holds and flees by the fastest route for as long as it can see you. It may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

rows.name: Feather Fall
rows.description: A reaction when you or nearby creatures fall: up to five falling creatures descend 60ft per round and take no damage when landing.

rows.name: Fey Ancestry
rows.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.

rows.name: Flash
rows.description: A soundless burst of white light at a creature's eye level; on a failed CON save it is blinded until the end of its next turn. Useless against a creature that cannot see, and it plainly announces that magic was cast.

duration.to: until the end of the target’s next turn

rows.reason: The blindness persists for the explicitly described duration.

rows.name: Fleeting Vitality
rows.description: Gain 1d4+4 temporary hit points for the duration.

rows.name: Fly
rows.description: The target gains a flying speed of 60ft for the duration.

rows.name: Globe of Invulnerability
rows.description: A faintly shimmering sphere surrounds you. No spell of tier 5 or lower cast from outside can affect anything within it — the magic simply fails at the boundary. Creatures and objects pass freely; the globe does not move with you.

rows.name: Gnomish Cunning
rows.description: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

rows.name: Grave Touch
rows.description: A chill of the grave; the target makes a CON save or has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

rows.name: Grease
rows.description: Slick grease coats the ground. A creature in the area when it appears, or entering it, makes a DEX save or falls prone; the area is difficult ground while it lasts. It burns if set alight.

rows.name: Guidance
rows.description: Once before the spell ends, the target adds 1d4 to one ability check of its choice.

rows.name: Guiding Bolt
rows.description: A ranged spell attack; 2d6 radiant on a hit, and the next attack roll against that target before the end of your next turn has advantage.

rows.name: Healing Word
rows.description: A bonus action: one creature you can see regains 1d4 + your spellcasting modifier HP. No effect on undead or constructs.

rows.name: Hellish Rebuke
rows.description: As a reaction to taking damage from an enemy you can see, wreathe it in hellish flame; it takes 2d10 fire, halved on a successful DEX save.

targets.to: an enemy you can see that damaged you

rows.reason: The reviewed trigger specifies a visible enemy.

rows.name: Hold Person
rows.description: A humanoid you can see must make a WIS save or be paralyzed. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Humanoids only — not beasts, undead, or monstrosities.

rows.name: Hunter's Mark
rows.description: Mark one creature you can see. Your weapon attacks against THAT target deal +1d6 damage, and you have advantage to track it. EXCLUSIVE: only one Hunter's Mark can exist at a time — casting it reassigns the mark to the new target. The mark fades upon the target's death.

duration.to: concentration, up to 1 hour; ends when the target dies

rows.reason: The mark fades on death in the selected rewrite.

rows.name: Ice Storm
rows.description: Fist-sized hailstones hammer down through everything in the cylinder; each creature makes a DEX save, taking 4d6 bludgeoning + 4d6 cold (half on a success). The ground is ice-slicked, difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

rows.name: Inflict Wounds
rows.description: Your next successful melee attack causes an additional 3d10 necrotic damage.  The spell fades after a successful attack or the resolution of combat.

targets.to: 1 creature hit by your next successful melee attack

duration.to: until a successful attack or the resolution of combat

dice.to: +3d10 necrotic on the next successful melee attack

rows.reason: The review changes this from an immediate touch attack to added damage on a later melee hit.

rows.name: Intimidating Presence
rows.description: A CHA check to terrify one creature. On a success it is shaken (-2 to all rolls) until it can no longer see you or the scene ends.

duration.to: until the target can no longer see you or the scene ends

rows.reason: Record the explicit ending condition instead of N/A.

rows.name: Invisibility
rows.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until it attacks, casts a spell, or the spell ends. Anything it is wearing or carrying is invisible too.

rows.name: Keen Senses
rows.description: Advantage on Perception checks that rely on sight, hearing, or smell.

rows.name: Lay on Hands
rows.description: Draw from a healing pool of 5 × your level: touch to restore HP, or spend 5 points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison. Cannot harm undead.

rows.name: Magic Weapon
rows.description: A nonmagical weapon becomes a magic weapon with +1 to attack and damage rolls for the duration.

rows.name: Mass Cure Wounds
rows.description: A wave of restorative energy washes over the point you choose; up to six creatures of your choice within it each regain 3d8 + your casting modifier HP. Undead and constructs are untouched.

rows.name: Message
rows.description: Whisper a short message to one creature within range that only it hears; it may whisper a one-line reply only you hear. Requires line of sight. Does NOT reach beyond 120ft — it is not telepathy or long-distance sending.

rows.name: Misty Step
rows.description: A bonus action: teleport up to 30ft to an unoccupied space you can see. Line of sight required — you cannot step through a wall you can't see past.

rows.name: Moonbeam
rows.description: A 5ft beam of moonlight; a creature that enters it or starts its turn there takes 2d10 radiant (CON save half). You may move the beam 60ft each turn.

rows.name: Poison Resistance
rows.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance (half damage) to poison.

rows.name: Radiant Strike
rows.description: Your next melee hit expends a slot to deal +2d8 radiant (more with a higher slot; +1d8 extra against undead or fiends).

duration.to: until the next melee hit; damage is instantaneous

rows.reason: The reviewed description charges the next melee hit.

rows.name: Ray of Enfeeblement
rows.description: A ray of enervation (ranged spell attack); the target deals only half damage with STR-based weapon attacks until the spell ends (CON save each turn to end it early).

rows.name: Ray of Frost
rows.description: A ranged spell attack; 1d8 cold on a hit and the target's speed drops by 10ft until the start of your next turn.

rows.name: Ray of Sickness
rows.description: A ray of sickly energy (ranged spell attack); 1d8 necrotic and, on a failed CON save, the target is poisoned until the end of your next turn.

rows.name: Reckless Attack
rows.description: Attack with advantage this turn; in exchange, attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

rows.name: Redirect Element
rows.description: A reaction when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage: gain resistance to that type until your next turn, and your next melee hit deals +1d6 of it.

rows.name: Resurrection
rows.description: Restores a dead creature to life with its body intact, so long as the soul consents. A century in the grave is not too long.

rows.name: Rot
rows.description: The greater Bleed: the target festers with necrotic sores, taking 1d6 necrotic at the start of each of its turns for 1d10 turns or until cancelled.

rows.name: Sacred Flame
rows.description: Radiant light falls on a creature you can see; it makes a DEX save or takes 1d8 radiant.  Cover is ignored.

rows.name: Sanctuary
rows.description: Ward one creature: an enemy that tries to attack or target it must first make a WIS save or be forced to pick a new target, or the attack is lost. No protection against area effects, and the ward ends immediately if the warded creature in any way attacks.

rows.name: Shadow Step
rows.description: From an area of dim light or darkness, teleport up to 30ft to another area of dim light or darkness in line of sight.

rows.name: Shield
rows.description: A reaction (cast when hit or targeted by Magic Missile): +5 AC until the start of your next turn, INCLUDING against the triggering attack, and negates Magic Missile.

rows.name: Shield Wall
rows.description: Reduce all incoming damage by 3 until the start of your next turn. Requires a shield or braced stance.

rows.name: Slow
rows.description: On a failed WIS save a creature's speed halves, it takes a penalty to AC and DEX saves, and it can take only one action or one bonus action on its turn. It may repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

rows.name: Smite
rows.description: Name a creature you can see and your god strikes it directly: a single blow equal to 95% of the hit points it has left, delivered in your deity's own idiom — a thunderclap, ghostly tentacles from the deep; the GM chooses the manifestation. It is never a killing blow: whatever it hits is left at death's door, and what happens next is up to you.

rows.name: Spare the Dying
rows.description: Stabilize a creature at 0 HP (it no longer needs death saves). No effect on undead or constructs.

rows.name: Staggering Smite
rows.description: Divine wrath rides your weapon. Your next hit deals +4d6 psychic, and the target makes a WIS save or reels — disadvantage on attacks and checks, and no reactions, until the end of its next turn.

rows.name: Stolen Voice
rows.description: The caster steals the target's voice.  While active, the caster's voice is indistinguishable from that of the target, and the target is left entirely unable to speak.  A successful Constitution save reduces the effect to a single utterance of the caster.

targets.to: 1 creature whose voice is stolen

save.to: CON: success limits the effect to one utterance

rows.reason: The target loses its voice; this is not self-only and the save shortens rather than negates it.

rows.name: The Line Holds
rows.description: Nobody breaks where you stand. Allies who can see or hear you cannot be routed, frightened or panicked, and the wounded among them keep their feet as long as you keep yours.

rows.name: The Wild Run
rows.description: The caster grants a run speed increase to themselves and their allies for the duration.  Those affected can run non-stop at double their normal speed for the duration of the spell.

rows.name: Thorn Lash
rows.description: A vine lashes out (melee spell attack at range); 1d6 piercing and, if the target is the same size as the caster or smaller, you pull it up to 10ft toward you.

rows.name: Turn Undead
rows.description: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30ft that fails a WIS save must spend its turns fleeing you and cannot willingly move closer, for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

rows.name: Uncanny Dodge
rows.description: If an attack hits you and you can see the attacker, you may spend your reaction to take half the damage from that attack. You have one reaction per round.

rows.name: Wall of Thorns
rows.description: Raise a dense barrier of sharp, thorn-covered vines, up to 20 feet in length, 10 feet in height and 3 feet thick. An opponent can break through by succeeding on a STR saving throw; failure leaves them restrained until they succeed on the save or are released. Contact with the vines deals 2d6 damage, which the saving throw does not reduce.

targets.to: wall up to 20ft long, 10ft high and 3ft thick

save.to: STR to pass through or escape restraint; does not reduce damage

rows.reason: Preserve the selected 2d6 wall and its dimensions and full contact damage.

rows.name: Abyssal Fury
rows.description: While below half your maximum HP, your melee attacks deal an extra 1d4 damage.

rows.name: Accelerate Decay
rows.description: Your touch rots living flesh: 2d8 necrotic and the target ages 1d10 years. What you rot stays rotted — wounds you deal cannot be magically healed until the next dawn.

rows.name: Afflict Curse
rows.description: WIS save or cursed — choose: disadvantage on one ability's checks and saves, OR vulnerability to one damage type, OR the target wastes its action on a roll of 1-4.

rows.name: Age
rows.description: Accelerates the target's age by 2d10 years (CON for half). Pushed beyond its natural span, the body begins to fail.

rows.name: Aid
rows.description: Bolster up to three creatures: their hit point maximum AND current HP each increase by 5 for 8 hours.

rows.name: Anchored Soul
rows.description: Your own soul rides in a prepared vessel: the first time you die, you wake beside it a day later and the vessel shatters. Crafting a new anchor takes a month. This is the apprenticeship for what waits at level 17.

rows.name: Ancient Shapes
rows.description: The moon shows you older beasts: forms long extinct — cave bears the size of carts, wolves from the first winters. Your shapes now frighten as they fight.

rows.name: Apex Predator
rows.description: Your marked quarry is already dead and its body just hasn't heard: your attacks against it crit on 18–20, it cannot hide from you, and your allies strike it harder for knowing you're on it.

rows.name: Arboreal Gate
rows.description: Once per round, step into a living tree and out of another of the same kind within 500ft — oak into oak, pine into pine. You know the location of every such tree in range while the spell lasts.

rows.name: Arcane Bolt
rows.description: A ranged spell attack (INT vs AC); 1d8 force on a hit. The sorcerer's reliable at-will strike.

rows.name: Arcane Shield
rows.description: A shimmer of force absorbs the next 5 damage you take, then dissipates. Raised as a reaction.
rows.reason: It dissipates when five damage is absorbed, not merely after one hit.

rows.name: Arcane Sight
rows.description: You see magic as plainly as light. Every enchantment, ward, curse and active spell declares itself; every illusion shows its brushstrokes; every disguised face shows the one beneath.

rows.name: Archmage Hand
rows.description: Your Mage Hand grown to full strength and reach: invisible, it can carry a person's weight, force a stuck door, wield a weapon at your direction, or throttle. It is as strong as you are and can be attacked only by dispelling.

rows.name: Army of Bone
rows.description: Waves of skeletons crash against the enemy, 25 at a time. As skeletons fall, new ones rise and join the fight. It continues until your concentration breaks.

rows.name: Arrest
rows.description: The guilty do not get to leave: once per scene, halt a fleeing foe where it stands — teleport, wings or terror avail it nothing for one full round.

rows.name: Aspect of the Reaper
rows.description: The caster manifests as the scythed icon of Death itself. Foes who behold it are petrified, one foe per round must save vs death or be reaped and die.

targets.to: foes who behold the caster; one foe per round for reaping

save.to: death save against reaping (one foe per round)

rows.reason: The caster transforms; it is not a projected image with a blanket WIS-negation save.

rows.name: Aspect of the Undead
rows.description: Take on the aspect of an undead creature appropriate to your power — a ghoul's paralyzing claws, a wraith's incorporeal drift, a mummy's dreadful gaze — gaining that creature's signature trait while the aspect holds.

rows.name: Astral Steed
rows.description: A silver-grey horse of solid starlight forms and will carry you tirelessly at speed, over ground a real horse would refuse. It vanishes if it takes any damage, and cannot fight.

rows.name: Aura of Courage
rows.description: Allies within 10ft cannot be frightened while you stand.

rows.name: Aura of Protection
rows.description: You and every ally within 10ft add your CHA modifier to all saving throws while you stand.

rows.name: Aura of Vitality
rows.description: For the duration, use a bonus action to heal one creature within 30ft for 2d6.

rows.name: Banish
rows.description: The target is hurled into a harmless demiplane and simply ceases to be here; a creature native to another plane is instead sent home. If your concentration holds the full minute, an extraplanar target does not come back.

rows.name: Barkskin
rows.description: The target's AC cannot be lower than 16 for the duration, regardless of armor worn.

rows.name: Barrage
rows.description: Hurl a weapon or ammunition to conjure a barrage; each creature in a 60ft cone takes 3d8 of the weapon's damage type (DEX save half).

rows.name: Battlefield Miracle
rows.description: Declare it, and for one scene no ally within your sight dies. They fall, they bleed, they are dragged from the field — and every one of them wakes up. Your enemies enjoy no such protection.

rows.name: Bend Luck
rows.description: Another's fortune is yours to nudge: steal a stumble from an ally's slip or gift one to an enemy's sure step (±1d4). A visible flicker of wrongness accompanies it — dice land on edge, bowstrings snap, the horseshoe falls.

rows.name: Blade of Corruption
rows.description: The target blade weeps black rot: +2d6 necrotic on every hit, and a wounded foe must save (CON) or the cut festers, refusing magical healing for a day.

rows.name: Bless
rows.description: Up to three creatures you choose add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws for the duration.

rows.name: Blight
rows.description: Moisture and vitality are drawn out of the target — 8d8 necrotic, CON for half. Plant creatures save at disadvantage, and ordinary plants simply die.

rows.name: Blindsense
rows.description: You know where every hidden or invisible creature within 10ft stands — breath, weight on a board, the wrongness in the air. Nothing that close can surprise you, and you strike what you cannot see there without penalty.

rows.name: Blink
rows.description: Teleport up to 30ft to a space you can see. On a failed DC 15 DEX check you arrive at a nearby unintended spot.

rows.name: Blood Armor
rows.description: Your own spilled blood hardens into crimson plate — +2 AC, and the armor drinks the first 15 points of damage before you feel anything.

rows.name: Blood for Blood
rows.description: Open your own veins and the wound appears on your enemy: sacrifice any amount of your hit points, and the target loses exactly that much. No save — blood pays for blood.

rows.name: Blood Price
rows.description: Taking damage adds another 10% to the damage you cause, on top of Gathering Rage. The count resets when the fight does.

rows.name: Blur
rows.description: Your outline swims and doubles. Attacks against you have disadvantage unless the attacker can see without eyes or otherwise ignores illusion.

rows.name: Bonded Companion
rows.description: A beast of the wild has chosen you: it fights beside you (acting on your turn), shares your instincts and obeys without words. If it dies, no other will choose you for a year and a day — the wild takes bonds seriously.

rows.name: Bone Armor
rows.description: Clad yourself in hardened, articulated bone platemail — the protection of plate with none of its weight or noise — for a scene.

rows.name: Bone Dragon
rows.description: Summon a bone dragon — wings, jaws and a breath of grave-dust — for a scene. It obeys you and nothing else.

rows.name: Bone Golem
rows.description: Build a golem of bone: strong as an ogre, tireless, obedient. It lasts until destroyed; you keep one at a time.

rows.name: Bone Shards
rows.description: Cast shards of bone at the target: 1d4 per caster level, out to 80 feet.

rows.name: Bone Structure
rows.description: Raise structures of bone from the ground — a wall, a bridge, a cage, a stair — shaped as you will. Fails on consecrated earth.

rows.name: Bone Whisper
rows.description: Touch a skull or bone fragment to sense an echo of its owner's final moments — a fleeting impression, not a conversation.

rows.name: Breathe Water
rows.description: The targets breathe water as easily as air for the duration. It grants no swimming speed and no protection from cold or pressure.

rows.name: Brutal Critical
rows.description: Roll one extra damage die whenever you land a critical hit.

rows.name: Call Lightning
rows.description: Summon a storm cloud; each turn as an action, call down a bolt — creatures within 5ft of the chosen point take 3d10 lightning (DEX save half).

rows.name: Call the Dawn
rows.description: CAPSTONE. When all is lost, call the dawn early: every ally standing with you is healed whole, freed of fear and curse, and cannot fall below 1 HP until the fight ends. The bards will get it wrong. It was better than they say.

rows.name: Camouflage
rows.description: While you remain motionless you blend into your native surroundings (stump/foliage, stone/rockwork, or shadow by heritage) and count as hidden. Any movement ends it.

rows.name: Catastrophic Wound
rows.description: Raw negative energy ravages the body — 14d6 necrotic (CON for half), and the target's maximum hit points are reduced by the damage taken until magically restored.
rows.reason: The description explicitly specifies 14d6, not 10d8.

rows.name: Chain Lightning
rows.description: A bolt strikes your chosen target for 10d8 lightning (DEX for half), then forks to as many as three more creatures within 30ft of it, each taking the same.

rows.name: Chaos Siphon
rows.description: Every surge in your sight — yours, a miscast, an artifact's tantrum — pours power back into you instead of taking it. Standing in another caster's catastrophe, you are the only one getting stronger.

rows.name: Charm Monster
rows.description: Any creature, not merely a person, regards you as a trusted friend on a failed WIS save. It will not obey obviously suicidal orders, and it knows it was charmed when the spell ends.

rows.name: Charybdis
rows.description: A vortex of life-draining negative energy surrounds you. Creatures starting their turn within 10ft take 2d8 necrotic (CON for half), and you gain half the damage dealt as hit points (up to your max).

rows.name: Cleanse
rows.description: Disease, poison, rot and afflictions of the body lift where you keep vigil: one night's work cures any single creature, and a plague ends in whatever village you stay in. It mends the body — what corrupts a soul is not your department.

rows.name: Cleansing Burn
rows.description: Your flames read intent: allies standing in fire you made take no harm and knit closed instead, and your fire ignores resistance — the wild flame is older than any ward built against it.

rows.name: Cold Reading
rows.description: Read unguarded moments — microexpressions, involuntary word choices, measured silences — with uncomfortable precision. Advantage on Insight checks to notice what someone is deliberately NOT saying, and to gauge the gap between what they say and what they mean.

rows.name: Combine Undead
rows.description: Fuses two or more of your undead servants into a single greater horror — hit points and strength pooled, and the whole crueler than its parts.

targets.to: 2 or more of your undead

rows.reason: The description says two or more rather than imposing a four-creature ceiling.

rows.name: Command
rows.description: Speak a one-word command (approach, drop, flee, grovel, halt, or similar); the target makes a WIS save or obeys on its next turn. It will not obey a directly harmful command, and the spell fails if it cannot understand you or is undead.

rows.name: Commune with Dead
rows.description: Once per day, briefly commune with a recently dead creature; for up to a minute it answers a few questions tersely and truthfully, limited to what it knew in life.

rows.name: Conscript Undead
rows.description: Seizes lasting control of an undead creature. Mindless undead simply obey; an intelligent one repeats its save at each dawn.

duration.to: lasting; intelligent undead can end it with a save at dawn

save.to: WIS: intelligent undead only; repeat at each dawn

rows.reason: Control persists; mindless undead simply obey and intelligent undead retry at dawn.

rows.name: Consecrate Ground
rows.description: Ground you hallow is yours: nothing unholy crosses it uninvited — undead and fiends must fight their own nature to come within 10ft — and the dying inside it do not slip away. A night's rite makes the consecration hold, and anyone who sleeps within wakes as though rested a week. Raising a new place lets the old go quiet.

rows.name: Consecrated Arms
rows.description: Every weapon your party carries counts as blessed while you are in the fight — the ghost, the fiend, the thing ordinary steel passes straight through takes the blow like anything else. Yours in particular has no bad angles.

rows.name: Control Water
rows.description: Command a body of water: raise a flood swell, part it to expose the bed, redirect a current, or spin a whirlpool that drags in vessels and swimmers (STR to pull free). One mode at a time, changeable each round.

rows.name: Controlled Chaos
rows.description: The surge is no longer blind. When your magic answers with its own idea it offers two, and you choose which one happens. Chaos has stopped happening to you and started negotiating.

rows.name: Counter Attack
rows.description: Roll a d20 against every melee attack made on you. On a roll under your character level you counter: you take HALF damage from that attack and immediately answer with an attack of your own. The trade is deliberate — you eat part of the blow to open the attacker up. At high level a Warrior surrounded by blades is the most dangerous thing in the room.

rows.name: Creeping Death
rows.description: A slow fog of decay crawls across the ground, advancing 10ft per round. Everything it passes over withers — 3d6 necrotic (CON for half); ordinary plant life dies outright.

rows.name: Cull the Herd
rows.description: When a foe drops to your attack, your momentum carries into the next: immediately strike another target in reach or range. The chain breaks only when you miss.

rows.name: Damn
rows.description: Condemns the target to the caster's equivalent of Hell.  A WIS saving throw spares the target the trip but holds them in place and causes fire damage.

targets.to: 1 creature

save.to: WIS: success prevents banishment but holds the target in place and deals fire damage

rows.reason: A successful save causes the lesser effect; the old failure-paralysis field reversed it.

rows.name: Dark Favor
rows.description: No darkness is dark to you, mundane or magical, and the dark answers small requests: torches gutter, shadows pool and stretch, a corner is unlit when you need one. Something on the far side of the dark knows your name now.

rows.name: Dark Immunity
rows.description: Immune to all forms of decay, disease, and death or blood magic.

rows.name: Darkness
rows.description: Magical darkness fills a 15ft-radius sphere; it blocks darkvision and ordinary light cannot illuminate it.

rows.name: Darkvision
rows.description: See in darkness within 60ft as though it were dim light, in shades of grey. Does not pierce magical darkness.

rows.name: Death Sight
rows.description: Sense undead, corpses, and death-taint within 60ft without seeing them, and gain advantage on Arcana/Lore checks about undead, curses, or death magic.

rows.name: Death Walk
rows.description: Step between the worlds of the living and dead: move up to INT x 5 ft unimpeded through creatures, objects, and difficult terrain, ignoring opportunity attacks.

rows.name: Decide the Battle
rows.description: CAPSTONE. In a battle you are fighting in, name the victor and the field goes that way: reinforcements arrive, the flank folds, the champion's horse throws them. The outcome is yours. The cost in the dead is not, and you will be counting it afterwards.

rows.name: Defer Death
rows.description: When you or anyone you can see drops, death is told to wait: they stand at 1 hit point instead of falling. The same creature cannot be spared twice in one day — the second time, the god is not listening.

rows.name: Destroy Undead
rows.description: Undead of lesser standing than you no longer flee when you turn them — they come apart where they stand. Anything older or greater than you still runs, and remembers who made it run.

rows.name: Devil's Trap
rows.description: A carefully drawn sigil that snares the first devil, demon, or undead to cross it — held fast within the circle (CHA negates on entry) until any line of the design is broken.

rows.name: Diamond Skin
rows.description: The target's skin hardens into faceted crystal, resistant to slashing and piercing for the duration. Light fractures off every plane of you — stealth is impossible while it lasts.
rows.reason: One target is transformed; the former self-radius label incorrectly describes an area.

rows.name: Dire Cremation
rows.description: Sets a corpse alight with unholy flame. Any creature that touches or strikes the pyre takes 2d10 fire-and-necrotic damage, and the flame leaps hungrily at attackers.

rows.name: Dire Phylactery
rows.description: Requires a focus object. While you focus on a target, every 5 hit points it loses are stored as 1 mana in the focus. The stored mana can later be drawn into you as a supply.

rows.name: Disciple of Life
rows.description: Every healing you work gives back more than it should, and your hands read a body at a touch: what broke it, how long it has, and whether the trouble is wound, poison, sickness or grief.

rows.name: Disguise Self
rows.description: Illusorily change your appearance — body and clothing/gear — until the spell ends. Physical inspection or an Investigation check reveals the disguise.

rows.name: Disintegrate
rows.description: A thin green ray unmakes what it touches. A creature that fails its DEX save takes 10d6+40 force; one reduced to 0 HP crumbles to fine grey dust — beyond the reach of Resurrection, which needs a body. A Wall of Force or 10ft cube of nonmagical matter is simply annihilated.

rows.name: Dispel Magic
rows.description: End one ongoing spell of 3rd tier or lower on the target automatically. For a higher-tier effect, make a spellcasting ability check (DC 10 + that spell's tier). Only affects ongoing magical effects, not instantaneous ones already resolved.

rows.name: Divine Intervention
rows.description: Pray aloud for your god to act directly. Roll d100; under your level it does — plainly, publicly, and in its own way. Answered or not, it will not be asked again for seven days.

rows.name: Divine Strike
rows.description: Your god blesses your weapon: once per turn a hit carries an extra d8 of your deity's own kind — light, flame, frost, rot — and the wound is unmistakably divine to anyone who looks at the body.

rows.name: Door That Opens
rows.description: Once per long rest, offer a creature a moment of genuine, non-magical safety. It gains advantage on its next Insight or Persuasion check made in your presence, and you learn one true thing it believes about itself.

rows.name: Double Attack
rows.description: You attack twice on your turn instead of once, and may split the two attacks between different targets.

rows.name: Draconic Breath
rows.description: Exhale destructive energy of your draconic bloodline — a 15ft cone or a 30ft line by heritage; each creature in the area takes 2d6 of your element (fire, cold, lightning, or acid), halved on a successful DEX save. Recharges on a rest.

rows.name: Drain Life
rows.description: A melee or 30ft necrotic touch; deal 1d6 necrotic and regain HP equal to half the damage dealt.

rows.name: Druid's Voice
rows.description: Cast druid spells while in Wild Shape — the beast's throat carries the words.

rows.name: Druidcraft
rows.description: Minor nature magic: predict the next 24h weather, make a flower bloom, create a harmless sensory effect, or light/snuff a small flame.

rows.name: Dwarven Toughness
rows.description: +1 maximum HP per character level.

rows.name: Earthquake
rows.description: The ground shakes, stones rise from the earth and tip over, enemies and walls alike crash to the ground.

rows.name: Eject Soul
rows.description: Knocks the target's soul clean out of its body. The vacant body stands slack and defenseless while the drifting soul can only watch; the soul snaps back when the spell ends — if the body still lives.

rows.name: Eldritch Tendrils
rows.description: Tendrils of void energy race outward in a line — 2d4 negative damage and a lingering bleed; CON for half and no bleed.

save.to: CON for half damage and no bleed

rows.reason: The reviewed description uses negative damage and specifies that a save prevents bleeding.

rows.name: Elemental Resistance
rows.description: Resistance (half damage) to one elemental damage type — fire, cold, lightning, or acid — fixed by your heritage.

rows.name: Elemental Shape
rows.description: Your Wild Shape reaches past flesh: elemental bodies — living flame, stone, water, wind — once per day each. The beasts were practice.

rows.name: Elemental Vein
rows.description: Your element cannot harm you, and it answers small requests without a spell: candle-flames bow, frost blooms across a window, sparks leap to your palm. Your spells of that element roll one extra damage die.

rows.name: Endless Rage
rows.description: Your rage lasts as long as the fight does, and dropping to 0 HP does not end it — you get one more round of fury on your feet before your body files its complaint.

rows.name: Ensnaring Strike
rows.description: The next time you hit with a weapon this turn, thorny vines sprout; the target makes a STR save or is restrained, taking 1d6 piercing each turn until it breaks free.

rows.name: Entangle
rows.description: Grasping weeds fill a 20ft square (difficult terrain); a creature there makes a STR save or is restrained until it breaks free with a STR check.

rows.name: Entropy Incarnate
rows.description: For one scene you are the ending of things: nonliving matter you touch turns to dust outright, hostile magic gutters out within 30ft of you, and living creatures who stand against you age a year and take 4d10 necrotic each round.

rows.name: Escape Artist
rows.description: No non-magical binding holds you: rope, manacles, chains, a locked cell, a press of hands. Given a few unobserved moments you are simply out. Magical restraints still hold.

rows.name: Evasion
rows.description: On a FAILED DEX save against an area effect, take half damage instead of full. (Class-feature Evasion later upgrades this to zero on a success.)

rows.name: Expertise — Deception
rows.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Deception checks.

rows.name: Expertise — Stealth
rows.description: Double your proficiency bonus on Stealth checks.

rows.name: Exploding Corpse
rows.description: Detonates a corpse in a burst of bone shards and rot — 6d6 damage to everything within 10ft, DEX for half.

rows.name: Eye of the Storm
rows.description: Allies inside your aura stand in the eye: your weather never touches them, and arrows shot into it are slapped aside by the wind.

rows.name: Fang and Focus
rows.description: Your claws and fangs bite through wards meant for steel (they count as magical), and the beast's throat can still carry your casting — roar the spell.

rows.name: Favored Quarry
rows.description: Study a creature for a breath and it is your quarry: you read its trail, its wounds and its next move, and your first strike against it each scene lands where it hurts.

rows.name: Feat of Strength
rows.description: Any feat of raw athleticism an ordinary human could dream of, you can simply do: leap the chasm, kick the oak door off its hinges, climb the sheer wall in rain, carry the wounded ox home. Feats at the very edge of mortal possibility may demand a check; feats within mortal imagination do not.

rows.name: Feral Instinct
rows.description: Advantage on initiative. If you are surprised while raging, you act normally anyway.

rows.name: Field Intelligence
rows.description: Detailed operational intelligence on organizations you have worked inside: chains of command, acquisition strategies, prior operations, funding sources. Your recall of a former employer's operations is treated as reliable; specifics live on your sheet.

rows.name: Field of Entropy
rows.description: A 30ft radius where everything ends faster: structures sag and crack, potions spoil, food blackens, healing is halved, and objects age a year every round.

rows.name: Fighting Style
rows.description: Choose one, permanently, when you gain this: Archery (+2 to ranged attacks), Defense (+1 AC in armor), Dueling (+2 damage with a lone one-handed weapon), Two-Weapon (add your modifier to the off-hand hit), Great Weapon (reroll 1s and 2s on two-handed damage), or Protection (once per round, impose disadvantage on an attack against an adjacent ally).

rows.name: Find Steed
rows.description: Summon a loyal spirit steed (warhorse, pony, etc.) bonded to you telepathically; it serves as a mount and ally until it drops to 0 HP or you dismiss it.

rows.name: Fire Bolt
rows.description: A ranged spell attack hurling a mote of fire; 1d8 fire on a hit. Ignites unattended flammable objects. Damage scales with caster level, not slots.

rows.name: Fire Lance
rows.description: A lance of flame; 1d10 fire on a hit and ignites unattended flammable targets.

rows.name: Fire Resistance
rows.description: Resistance (half damage) to fire damage.

rows.name: Fireball
rows.description: A bright streak blossoms into flame at a point you choose; each creature in a 20ft-radius sphere makes a DEX save, taking 8d6 fire (half on a success). Ignites unattended flammable objects.

rows.name: Firestorm Shepherd
rows.description: Whistle up a wildfire the size of a hill and walk it like a hound: it moves where you point, spares every living thing you name, and where it has passed, flowers open by morning. Armies break before it; forests thank you after.

rows.name: Flamestep
rows.description: Step into any fire you can see and out of any other: a candle is a door, a burning village is a hall of doors. Once per scene, arrive as a burst — 2d8 fire around your exit, allies excepted, as always.

rows.name: Flash Flood
rows.description: Causes a rush of water to issue forth from the caster's outstretched hands causing all entities within range to attempt a STR save or be washed back 100 feet taking tumbling damage.  Small creatures get no saving throw, giant creatures get a bonus +2 to saving throw.

targets.to: all entities in a 100ft cone

save.to: STR to avoid being washed back; Small creatures get no save; giant creatures gain +2

rows.reason: The save prevents displacement; it is not an escape check after restraint.

rows.name: Flesh Golem
rows.description: Stitches several corpses into one hulking flesh golem bound to your will. It does not tire, does not fear, and does not question.

rows.name: Fletch
rows.description: The Ranger conjures a dozen ethereal arrows.  +2 to hit, +2 to damage.

targets.to: 12 conjured ethereal arrows

rows.reason: The description grants attack/damage bonuses to a dozen arrows, not 2d8 radiant damage.

rows.name: Fog Bank
rows.description: A bank of dense fog rolls out and fills the area, heavily obscuring everything inside it. Creatures within cannot see out, and those outside cannot see in. A strong wind disperses it in a round.

rows.name: Font of Magic
rows.description: Your power is a reservoir in the blood, not a book. You always know exactly how much magic you have left, and at a glance how nearly spent any other caster in sight is. The reading is never wrong.

rows.name: Freedom of Movement
rows.description: The target ignores difficult terrain; magic can neither reduce its speed nor paralyze nor restrain it; it slips any grapple, manacle or net by spending 5ft of movement; and water imposes no penalty on its movement or attacks.

rows.name: Furious Leap
rows.description: The gap between you and your prey is never safe: leap your full movement onto any foe, arriving as an attack that puts them on the ground (STR resists the knockdown).

rows.name: Gathering Rage
rows.description: Each attack after the first in a fight adds another 10% to the damage you deal, building as long as you keep swinging. Stop, and the count starts over.

rows.name: Gemstone Warriors
rows.description: Three warrior-shaped constructs of living gemstone rise where you point (AC 17, 40 HP each). They act on your turn and obey your spoken commands; at 0 HP or when the spell ends they shatter into worthless shards.

rows.name: Giant Insect
rows.description: Ordinary vermin swell to monstrous size — a spider the size of a hound, a wasp like a hawk — and obey your spoken commands. They revert when the spell ends or they are slain.

rows.name: Greater Invisibility
rows.description: The target and everything it wears and carries vanish completely. Unlike lesser invisibility, attacking and casting do NOT break it — only the spell's end brings the target back into view.

rows.name: Greater Restoration
rows.description: Ends one severe affliction on the target: a curse, a petrification, a charm or possession, one level of exhaustion, or any reduction to its ability scores or maximum HP.

rows.name: Greater Vessels
rows.description: Once per day you bind at 30ft the instant death occurs, and your vessels hold souls indefinitely.

rows.name: Grim Harvest
rows.description: When you kill a creature with a spell, regain HP equal to twice the spell's tier. Once per turn.

dice.from: regain HP equal to twice the spell's tier (minimum 2)
dice.to: regain HP equal to twice the spell's tier

rows.reason: Remove the unsupported minimum of two, which conflicts with twice the tier for tier-zero spells.

rows.name: Grim Totem
rows.description: Raises a six-foot obelisk of fused bone. Each round it stands, it drags one skeleton out of the earth to serve you — one per round, for half your level in rounds.

rows.name: Group Telepathy
rows.description: You link a party in silent speech — everyone hears everyone, at a mile's spread, through walls and noise. Perfect for a heist and ruinous for an argument; a linked creature may close its end at will.

rows.name: Guided Strike
rows.description: Once per fight a miss becomes a hit — yours, or any companion's you can see. Your god corrects the swing visibly, and everyone on the field knows whose hand did it.

rows.name: Hail of Thorns
rows.description: Your next ranged weapon hit bursts into thorns: creatures within 5ft of the target take 1d10 piercing (DEX save half).

rows.name: Heal
rows.description: A surge of pure life restores the target to perfect health.  All HP are restored.  All negative effects are removed.  Any missing limbs are restored. Undead and constructs are untouched.

rows.name: Hemorrhage
rows.description: Ruptures the target's vessels from within — 4d6 necrotic, and they bleed 1d4 per round until tended. CON for half and no bleed.

rows.name: Heroes' Feast
rows.description: A magnificent feast appears. Those who share the full hour are cured of disease and poison, and for 24 hours are immune to poison and to fear, and carry 2d10 bonus maximum HP.

rows.name: Hide in Plain Sight
rows.description: You disappear into whatever surrounds you. In a crowd or a household you become one of them — posture, pace and business all wrong for the person being hunted. In the wild you take on the cover itself: motionless against rock, bracken or snow, effectively invisible to a passing eye. Someone actively searching may contest with Perception; acting overtly ends it.

rows.name: Hold Monster
rows.description: Paralyzes any creature — beast, fiend, giant, anything with a mind to seize, not merely humanoids. Attacks against the frozen target from within 5ft strike true and deadly.

rows.name: Hold Undead
rows.description: Paralyzes undead where they stand. Mindless undead get no save; intelligent ones repeat theirs at the end of each round.

rows.name: Hole
rows.description: A real hole, 5ft across and 10ft deep, opens in floor or wall. A creature standing there makes a DEX save or drops in (2d6). When the spell ends the hole seals — anything still inside is shunted out, prone.

rows.name: Holy Ground
rows.description: Create a zone of consecrated ground.  The zone may not be crossed by undead, devils, or demons.  Undead, devils, or demons in the zone at the time of casting are immediately repelled  to the nearest available boundary.  In the event no escape is available, Divine damage equal to the caster's level * 10 is applied per round.

targets.to: a zone barred to undead, devils and demons

dice.to: 10 × caster level divine damage per round to trapped undead, devils or demons

rows.reason: The zone affects specified creatures and explicitly damages those unable to escape.

rows.name: Horrid Wilting
rows.description: Sucks the moisture from every living thing in the area — 10d8 necrotic, CON for half. Plant and water-born creatures save at disadvantage.

rows.name: Hound of Ill Omen
rows.description: Whisper a name into a shadow and a hound of it steps out to harry that creature. It does not tire, it does not lose the trail, and its quarry sleeps badly until the hound is called off or destroyed.

rows.name: Identify Plants and Animals
rows.description: Accurately identify and describe a plant or animal in the druid's line of sight. Includes alchemical uses as well as animal abilities and behaviors.

targets.to: 1 plant or animal in line of sight

rows.reason: The description imposes no huge-or-smaller plant restriction.

rows.name: Implant Memory
rows.description: You give the target a memory of something that did not happen, no longer than a few minutes and no more unlikely than their own life allows. They recall it as their own and will act and testify on it. Hard evidence to the contrary lets them doubt it. The counterpart to Oubliate: this ADDS to what a mind holds rather than taking away.

rows.name: Indomitable
rows.description: Once per rest, reroll a saving throw you have just failed and take the second result. You set your feet against the thing that should have moved you.

rows.name: Inevitably
rows.description: Once per day, when a chosen target is within 150 feet, nothing bars your approach: walls have gaps, wards have seams, guards are looking elsewhere, and you arrive at the target's side as though the fortress itself conspired. Beyond 150 feet the fortress owes you nothing. The approach is movement only — the kill is still yours to make, and leaving is your own problem.

rows.name: Insect Plague
rows.description: A roiling sphere of biting locusts. The area is lightly obscured, difficult terrain; a creature entering it or starting its turn there makes a CON save against 4d10 piercing.

rows.name: Iron Constitution
rows.description: Every Constitution saving throw you make succeeds automatically — poison, disease, exhaustion, the cold that kills lesser men — except on a natural 1, which fails as it always would. Your body has stopped negotiating.

save.to: CON saves automatically succeed except on a natural 1

rows.reason: Preserve the explicit natural-one exception.

rows.name: Judge of the Dead
rows.description: No soul passes within a mile without your leave: the dying linger until you rule, and the dead cannot be raised against you. Once — only once — you may spend every soul you hold to call one person truly back to life.

rows.name: Judgment's Eye
rows.description: Lies rot in your gaze: you always know when you're told a falsehood, and once per scene you may compel one creature to answer a single question truly.

rows.name: Juggernaut
rows.description: While you still have hit points, nothing takes you out of the fight: you cannot be stunned, paralyzed, restrained, knocked prone, disarmed, grappled, or moved against your will, by any means mundane or magical. You can be killed. You cannot be handled — and every commander who has faced you knows it.

rows.name: Kindled Heart
rows.description: A mote of living wildfire rides with you: hurl it each round (1d8 fire, 30ft, no mana), and it never touches what you love — your fire cannot harm an ally unless you will it.

rows.name: Kinship of the Wild
rows.description: Any beast will hear you out. Once per scene, ask the wild a favor — a hawk to carry word, wolves to harry a column, rats to empty a granary by dawn.

rows.name: Knock
rows.description: A sharp clang unlocks or unbars one locked/stuck object within range. The knock is audible out to 300ft.

rows.name: Land's Stride
rows.description: Brush, bog, scree and snow cost you nothing: you move through wild ground at full pace where others crawl, and thorns and briars part rather than tear.

rows.name: Last One Standing
rows.description: Pain, exhaustion, and wounds do not slow you: you fight at full strength however hurt you are, and conditions that would merely slow or weaken you do not (those that bind, charm, or fell you outright still can). While an ally is in danger you do not drop from wounds alone — you go down when the fight is done, or when death itself takes you.

rows.name: Layout Memory
rows.description: After one pass through a building or location, retain an accurate mental map of it: entry points, weak latches, guard rhythms, storage placement.

rows.name: Leap
rows.description: The target's jumping distance triples — rooftop to rooftop, a chasm, a courtyard wall. It does not slow a fall at the far end.

rows.name: Leave No Witness
rows.description: A foe you drop from stealth goes down silently — no cry, no clatter, no alarm — and nothing you do in darkness reveals where you are.

rows.name: Ledger Memory
rows.description: Recall with perfect clarity any contract, debt, name, or obligation you have personally witnessed or been bound to. An INT check (DC 12) identifies whether a symbol, cipher, or document belongs to a known contractual tradition.

rows.name: Legendary Companion
rows.description: Your companion has grown into something from the old stories — dire-sized, cunning as a person, known by name in three kingdoms. Enemies plan around it now, not you.

rows.name: Legerdemain
rows.description: If an object is within your reach, you can already have taken it — pockets picked, rings slipped from fingers, a knife from its sheath — with none the wiser at the time. Victims discover the loss later. A creature actively watching its property may contest with Perception against your Sleight of Hand.

rows.name: Lesser Restoration
rows.description: End one disease OR one condition on a creature: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

rows.name: Lethe's Kiss
rows.description: WIS save or the target loses up to 15 minutes of memory per point of your INT modifier — recent events simply vanish. The narrative-only sibling of Oubliate.

rows.name: Light
rows.description: An object you touch sheds bright light in a 20ft radius and dim light 20ft beyond — steady, heatless, and smotherable by covering the object. Casting it again moves the glow.

rows.name: Light Undimmed
rows.description: Your radiance becomes a fact of the region: within your aura all healing is doubled, all darkness is merely shade, and lies stumble on their way out of the mouth.

rows.name: Lightning Arrow
rows.description: Your next ranged attack becomes lightning: 4d8 lightning on a hit (2d8 on a miss), and creatures within 10ft of the target take 2d8 (DEX save half).

rows.name: Lightning Strike
rows.description: Point at what the sky should hate: once per round a bolt falls on a foe within 60ft.

rows.name: Locate Creature
rows.description: Name or picture a creature you have seen; you sense the direction and rough distance to the nearest instance of it within 1000ft. Running water wider than 10ft breaks the trail.

rows.name: Lockpick
rows.description: Open locks and disarm mechanical traps with a DEX check against the device's DC. Requires thieves' tools.

rows.name: Mage Hand
rows.description: Conjure a floating spectral hand that can manipulate objects, open unlocked doors/containers, and carry up to 10 lb. It cannot attack, activate magic items, or wield weapons.

rows.name: Magic Missile
rows.description: Three darts of force strike targets you can see, one dart each or combined; each auto-hits for 1d4+1 force. No attack roll, no save.

rows.name: Magical Sustenance
rows.description: The flesh is half power now. You barely need food, sleep or air; poison and disease find nothing to grip; you age at a crawl. The frailty remains — what cuts you still cuts.

rows.name: Mana Burn
rows.description: Ignite up to 6 mana in the target's pool, destroying it; the combusting mana sears them for 1 damage per point destroyed. A WIS save halves both the mana destroyed and the damage (rounded down). A creature without a mana pool is unaffected.

rows.name: Mana Leech
rows.description: Tear up to 4 mana from the target's pool; half of what is torn free (rounded down) flows into your own pool. A creature without a mana pool is unaffected.

rows.name: Mass Charm
rows.description: A whole room takes you for a friend on a failed WIS save — a guardroom, a council, a crowd. Each knows it was charmed afterwards, which makes this a spell that buys time and costs reputation.

rows.name: Master Poisoner
rows.description: Given moments and whatever is at hand — kitchen herbs, lamp oil, the scorpion from a boot — you render any food, drink, or weapon lethally poisoned, instantly and creatively. Onset and symptoms are yours to design: immediate, slow, or mimicking illness. Ordinary folk simply succumb; hardened or named foes may resist with a CON save.

rows.name: Metamagic
rows.description: Bend a spell's shape as you cast it: quicken it to an instant, twin it onto a second target, stretch its range or duration, or work it with no word or gesture at all. One shaping per casting, on top of the spell's own cost.

rows.name: Miasma
rows.description: A cloud of despair; creatures inside are wracked with grief and hopelessness — WIS save or act at disadvantage while within it.

rows.name: Minor Illusion
rows.description: Create either a sound or a static visual image no larger than a 5ft cube; an Investigation check discerns it is false.

rows.name: Minor Miracle
rows.description: Spend your god's authority out loud and it answers in its own idiom — light in a dark place, a binding broken, a frightened crowd's courage handed back. The god answers the priest, not the request: what arrives is what your deity would give, not what you asked for.

rows.name: Mirror Image
rows.description: Three illusory duplicates flit around you; when something targets you, an attack may strike a duplicate instead (destroying it) rather than you.

rows.name: More Than Mortal
rows.description: Strength and Constitution push past the mortal ceiling. Doors, chains and 'impossible' are all suggestions now.

rows.name: Necrotic Resilience
rows.description: Resistance to necrotic damage and advantage on death saving throws. Undead you control cannot be turned by clerics or paladins.

rows.name: Necrotic Resistance
rows.description: Resistance (half damage) to necrotic damage.

rows.name: Never Caught
rows.description: The first time in a scene you would be seized, cornered, bound, or otherwise physically taken, you simply are not — you were already elsewhere, and those present half-remember deciding to let you go. Does not prevent damage, only capture.

rows.name: No Light Needed
rows.description: You see perfectly in any darkness, mundane or magical, and darkness likes you back: within 30ft of you torches gutter and lanterns shrink to a glow.

rows.name: No Lock Holds
rows.description: Locks, knots, seals, shackles, and mechanical traps open for you as though they wanted to: given a few moments and anything resembling a pick, treat them as unlocked. Masterwork or magical closures take longer and may demand a check, but never stop you cold — a lock is a suggestion.

rows.name: No Rest for the Wicked
rows.description: Your named enemy cannot lose you: you sense their direction within a day's ride, and while the hunt is on you need half the sleep and none of the comfort.

rows.name: Oathlight
rows.description: Your weapon carries your oath without being asked: every hit deals +1d8 radiant, and creatures of darkness find the light sticky — it clings, and marks them for everyone to see.

rows.name: Old Blood
rows.description: The dragon in your line wakes. Fine scales harden your skin where armor would sit (+1 AC unarmored); one element runs in your veins, chosen once — flame, frost, storm or venom; and dragons and their kin know you on sight for what you carry.

rows.name: One Against Many
rows.description: Surrounded is where you are strongest: when several foes engage you in melee, every one of them is within your reach, none of them gains any edge from numbers, and a blow that fells one may carry into the next. A room of soldiers is a queue.

rows.name: One With the Night Sky
rows.description: Starlight thins you: blades and arrows dim as they land, you no longer need sleep or breath — you keep watch the way the stars do — and moonlight and starlight bear your weight as solid ground.

rows.name: One with the Wild
rows.description: In natural terrain you cannot be tracked, ambushed or outpaced, and beasts will not raise a claw against you unprovoked.

rows.name: Operative's Read
rows.description: Once per short rest, assess a person's likely loyalty, fear threshold, or hidden motive with a WIS check (DC 12). On a success, the GM reveals one concealed motivation.

rows.name: Oubliate
rows.description: WIS save or surgically erase ONE specific person or event from the target's memory entirely (the engine scrubs it via [NPC_FORGET:]); they cannot recall it even when reminded.

rows.name: Overchannel
rows.description: Push a spell past its ceiling: maximum possible effect, no roll. The price is paid in your own body — 1d6 per tier of the spell — and those wounds refuse all healing until you next sleep. The power was never free; it was borrowed.

rows.name: Pack of Two
rows.description: You fight as one animal in two bodies: when either of you lands a hit, the other may immediately strike the same target.

rows.name: Paragon of Honesty
rows.description: Your presence is an oath others lean on: allies who can see you cannot be charmed or made afraid — and your word, once given, is impossible for you to break, and everyone can feel that it is.

rows.name: Pass Without Trace
rows.description: You and allies within 30ft gain +10 to Stealth and cannot be tracked by nonmagical means, leaving no tracks or scent.

rows.name: Path of the Lich
rows.description: The path to becoming a lich is open to you. It is taken once and cannot be untaken.

rows.name: Penance
rows.description: Causes the target to suffer damage equivalent to all damage they've caused during the current conflict.

rows.name: Phantasmal Force
rows.description: Craft an illusion in ONE target's mind that it believes is real — it rationalizes any illogic away. Only the target perceives it. If the phantasm would harm it (fire, a collapsing beam), it takes 1d6 psychic each round it is affected. An action + INT check lets it disbelieve.

rows.name: Plant Growth
rows.description: Overgrow a 100ft radius into difficult terrain (movement quartered) — or, over 8 hours, enrich the land for a year of bountiful harvest.

rows.name: Poison Immunity
rows.description: Natural poisons and venoms have no effect on you.

rows.name: Polymorph
rows.description: Transforms the target into a beast of your choice of equal or lesser power — its gear melds away, its mind dulls to the beast's, and it uses the beast's body as temporary vitality. It reverts when that vitality is spent or the spell ends, at the HP it had before.

rows.name: Possess Thrall
rows.description: Project your mind into one of your undead thralls, seeing and speaking through it; your own body lies in suspended animation until you withdraw.

duration.from: 1 turn per INT point or until you withdraw

rows.reason: The description maintains possession until withdrawal rather than limiting it by INT turns.

rows.name: Powerful Strike
rows.description: On a declared attack, add +1d6 damage on a hit. Declared before the roll.

rows.name: Presence of the Wyrm
rows.description: Let the old blood fill the room. Lesser creatures' nerve breaks under your attention — they flee, freeze or yield (WIS resists); hardened ones bargain more carefully. Neither charm nor fear: the older thing both descend from.

rows.name: Preserve Life
rows.description: Catch someone in the first moments after death — a creature dead less than a minute stands again at 1 hit point, whole enough to walk. What they saw while they were gone is between them and your god.

rows.name: Prestidigitation
rows.description: Minor magical tricks: light or snuff a small flame, clean or soil an object, chill/warm/flavor food, make a harmless sensory effect, or a trivial mark.

rows.name: Primal Avalanche
rows.description: Your charge breaks formations: shield walls scatter, gates crack, cavalry balks. Enemy commanders write their orders around where you might be.

rows.name: Primal Icon
rows.description: The totem wears YOU: become the spirit made flesh for a scene — a bear the size of a wagon, an eagle that blots the torchlight, a wolf out of the first winter. Your legend and the spirit's are the same story now.

rows.name: Produce Flame
rows.description: A flame in your hand sheds light; you may hurl it as a ranged spell attack for 1d8 fire (ending the spell).

rows.name: Quills
rows.description: The target grows short but sharp quills which will damage any opponent touching them.

rows.name: Rage
rows.description: Enter a battle fury: +2 STR, +2 melee damage, and you push through pain (resist physical damage, ignore first wounds). Lasts 3 rounds. Ends early if you take no hostile action.

rows.name: Raise Thrall
rows.description: Animate a fresh corpse within 10ft as a zombie thrall that follows basic commands. Requires a body present. ONE thrall at a time (until the archetype expands it); the thrall collapses if you fall unconscious.

rows.name: Read the Beast
rows.description: One look tells you any creature's strengths, its weaknesses and how much fight it has left — exact wounds, what it resists, and the move it will make next.

rows.name: Read the Night
rows.description: The sky briefs you: once per scene, ask the stars one question about what is coming and receive a true sign. Any ally you share the sign with carries its light on the one roll it warned them about.

rows.name: Reap the Field
rows.description: Any creature that dies within 60ft offers you its soul — no action, no vessel prepared, you ARE the vessel. Battles fill your satchel; armies feed you.

rows.name: Reap the Whirlwind
rows.description: Numbers stop meaning anything: foes gain no advantage from surrounding or flanking you, their opportunity strikes miss, and when three or more engage you, it is you who has the advantage.

rows.name: Relentless Endurance
rows.description: Once per day, when you would be reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, you drop to 1 HP instead.

rows.name: Resilience
rows.description: Your body closes its own wounds: you recover 1 hit point per character level for every hour that passes, resting or not. A Warrior who walks away from a battlefield is whole again by nightfall without a healer.

rows.name: Restore Limb
rows.description: A night of prayer over the wounded regrows what was lost: an arm, a leg, an eye, a hand — anything short of a head. The new flesh is whole, strong and unmistakably a gift; it carries no scar, and everyone who knew the old wound knows exactly who to thank.

rows.name: Revivify
rows.description: Return a creature that died within the last minute to life with 1 HP. Cannot restore missing body parts, revive undead/constructs, or one dead of old age.

rows.name: Rewrite the Odds
rows.description: CAPSTONE. Name one moment of pure chance — a fall, a storm, a draw, a die — and declare its outcome, however impossible. It happens exactly as spoken. Chance owed you one, and everyone watching learns it paid.

rows.name: Ride the Wind
rows.description: The storm carries its own: leap gaps no mortal could, and fall from any height into a thunderclap landing that costs you nothing.

rows.name: Rigor Mortis
rows.description: CON save or the target seizes rigid and incapacitated.

rows.name: Ritual Working
rows.description: Conduct binding and consecration rituals in a commanding pre-common ritual tongue: consecrate altar stones, levitate and activate attuned ritual objects, produce controlled light phenomena. Slow, deliberate workings — not combat magic.

rows.name: Root and Branch
rows.description: The green fights for you unasked: difficult terrain never slows you, and once per scene the undergrowth itself restrains everything you name within 30ft.

rows.name: Roots of the World
rows.description: Tree, stone and stream confide in you — what passed, when, and bleeding or not. Once per day the land opens a path: brush parts, fords surface, cliffs offer stairs.

rows.name: Ruin
rows.description: A minute of ritual collapses years into moments on one structure: a fortress gate becomes a breach, a bridge becomes a memory, a siege engine becomes mulch. Consecrated ground resists.

rows.name: Rust
rows.description: Your decay no longer needs touch — corrode objects at 30ft. Once per round, when a nonmagical weapon or projectile strikes you, it decays mid-blow: damage halved, the weapon ruined.

rows.name: Saint's Vessel
rows.description: Your body is consecrated ground: hostile magic must overcome your conviction (CHA) to touch you at all, and wherever you sleep counts as hallowed.

rows.name: Sap and Stone
rows.description: Poison, rot and wither slide off you and those at your side, and your body keeps the forest's calendar — you age a year for its ten.

rows.name: Sapient Spark
rows.description: After a day-long ritual, the target wakes: human-like intelligence, speech, and — for a plant — the power to move. It is charmed toward you for 30 days; what it chooses after that depends entirely on how you treated it.

rows.name: Scorching Ray
rows.description: Three rays of fire; make a separate ranged spell attack for each, 2d6 fire per hit. Split among one or more targets.

rows.name: Season of Wrath
rows.description: Your rage bends the weather for miles — fog to hide a retreat, a squall to ground the enemy's archers, a killing frost at midsummer. The land keeps your grudges.

rows.name: Season's Champion
rows.description: The wild rises where you fight: for a scene the terrain takes your side — thorn hedges, sudden bogs, groves that hide your friends and swallow your enemies.

rows.name: Second Skin
rows.description: Wild Shape is a breath, not a ritual: shift as part of any action, gear melding or staying as you choose, and your beast ceiling keeps climbing with your level.

rows.name: See in Magical Darkness
rows.description: Your darkvision pierces even magically created darkness.

rows.name: See Invisible
rows.description: You perceive invisible creatures and objects as faint, wavering outlines.

rows.name: Sentence Passed
rows.description: Your smites against the named enemy cannot be resisted, reduced or forgiven — and each one breaks a hold their power has over someone else.

rows.name: Sentinel
rows.description: A dim, blade-bearing sentinel of light appears and keeps watch. Enemies that enter the watched radius or start their turn there take 20 radiant (DEX for half). The guardian fades after it has dealt 60 total damage.

rows.name: Set the Scene
rows.description: When you kill, you choose what the death appears to be: a fall, a fever, a stopped heart, too much drink. Examination by ordinary means confirms your version; only magical inquiry or a master healer's close autopsy may contest it (Investigation against your Deception). What actually happened is never altered — only what the world reads from the body.

rows.name: Seventy-Two Shapes
rows.description: Take the form of any person or creature of roughly your size that you have seen — voice, face, bearing. It holds until you choose to end it, and does not drop when you are struck. It grants none of the form's abilities or statistics; someone who knows the original well may contest with Insight on close interaction.

rows.name: Shackles of Bone
rows.description: Skeletal arms erupt from earth or wall to pin the target prone or against a surface; it is restrained until it snaps the bones with a STR check.

rows.name: Shadow Walk
rows.description: Every shadow is a door. Step into one and out of any other you have stood in before, however far — the cold between them crossed in a single held breath. What lives in that cold has learned to let you pass.

rows.name: Shape Shift
rows.description: The caster takes on the physical form of anything they've touched in the past, from a chair to a dragon.  Everything is fair game.  The caster retains their intellect but any abilities associated with their previous form are swapped with the new form.

rows.name: Shared Senses
rows.description: Close your eyes and use your companion's: see, hear and scent through it at any distance you could walk in a day.

rows.name: Shield of Faith
rows.description: A shimmering field grants a creature you can see +2 AC for the duration.

rows.name: Shield the Weak
rows.description: Once per round, take a blow meant for anyone within reach — and take it better than they would have: half damage to you.

rows.name: Shillelagh
rows.description: Your wooden club or quarterstaff becomes magical: use your spellcasting mod for its attacks and it deals 1d8 for the duration.

rows.name: Shrink
rows.description: The target halves in every dimension — through a grate, into a pocket, under a door. A shrunken creature has disadvantage on STR checks and deals a die less damage; an object's weight drops with it.

rows.name: Shrug It Off
rows.description: While raging, halve all damage that isn't an attack on your mind. Pain is information, and you've stopped reading your mail.

rows.name: Sigil Reading
